# CKM Catering (ចេង គួងម៉េង) - Premier Catering in Phnom Penh

> CKM (Cheng Koung Meng / ចេង គួងម៉េង) is Cambodia's premier Sino-Khmer luxury catering and banquet service provider based in Phnom Penh, bringing over 60 years of master culinary tradition to weddings, corporate galas, housewarming events, and private VIP banquets.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Culinary Legacy**: Over 60 years of master chef experience in authentic Khmer and Chinese banquet cuisine.
- **Service Range**: Weddings, Corporate Events, Housewarming Parties, Live Cooking Receptions, and Outdoor Tent Infrastructure.
- **Service Area**: Phnom Penh and surrounding provinces across Cambodia (Kandal, Kampong Cham, Siem Reap, etc.).
- **Capacity**: From intimate VIP private dinners (2-5 tables) to large-scale wedding banquets (50-200+ tables).

## Key Service Offerings
- **Traditional 8-Course Wedding Menu (ម្ហូបការ ៨ មុខ)**: Multi-course banquet featuring signature Sino-Khmer dishes.
- **Budgeting & Tasting (ការភ្លក់រសជាតិម្ហូប)**: Pre-event food tasting and flexible pricing per table.
- **Full Infrastructure Setup (រៀបចំរោងការ និងតុអាហារ)**: Air-conditioned VIP tents, luxury tableware, professional waitstaff, and hygiene-controlled mobile kitchens.
